aka.en: Ningbo–Taizhou–Wenzhou second expressway, Zhejiang coastal expressway
aka.zh: 甬台温高速公路复线、浙江沿海高速公路

tagline.en: A second coast road beside the Shenyang–Haikou expressway, finished in 2022 when a three-tower double-deck bridge closed the last gap across the Oujiang at Wenzhou
tagline.zh: 沈海高速旁的第二条沿海通道，2022 年温州瓯江口一座三塔双层大桥补上最后缺口后全线贯通

start.en: Dayouyuan interchange, Dongguan, Guangdong, on the Pearl River Delta ring and Dongguan–Foshan expressways — kilometre 1,469
start.zh: 广东省东莞市大有园枢纽，接珠三角环线高速与莞佛高速——1469 公里处

end.en: Yunlong interchange with the Ningbo ring expressway, Yinzhou District, Ningbo, Zhejiang — kilometre 0
end.zh: 浙江省宁波市鄞州区云龙枢纽，接宁波绕城高速——零公里点

en: G1523 is one of the parallel lines of G15, the Shenyang–Haikou expressway, and runs beside it along the south-east coast for 1,469 km: 384 km in Zhejiang, 690 in Fujian and 395 in Guangdong. The plan's control points are Ningbo, Xiangshan, Taizhou, Yuhuan, Wenzhou, Fuding, Ningde, Fuzhou, Yongtai, Xianyou, Anxi, Zhangzhou, Pinghe, Chaozhou, Jieyang, Luhe, Huidong and Dongguan. In Zhejiang it keeps nearer the sea than G15, crossing the bays from Xiangshan to Yueqing; in Fujian it swings inland behind Putian, Quanzhou and Xiamen by Yongtai, Xianyou and Anxi; in Guangdong it runs west through Chaozhou and Jieyang and behind the Shanwei coast to Huizhou and Dongguan.

It was assembled from roads the provinces built under their own names: the Zhejiang coastal expressway, also called the second Ningbo–Taizhou–Wenzhou expressway; the Fuzhao expressway, or second Shenyang–Haikou expressway, in Fujian; and the Chaozhou–Dongguan expressway, formerly provincial S20, in Guangdong. The 2013 national highway plan numbered it G15W3; the 2022 plan renumbered it G1523. It shares carriageway with G15 at Yueqing, Fuding and Ningde, and with the Fuzhou ring and several other expressways around Fuzhou, Xiamen and Zhangzhou.
zh: G1523 是 G15 沈海高速的并行线之一，沿东南沿海与 G15 并行，全长 1469 公里：浙江 384 公里，福建 690 公里，广东 395 公里。规划主要控制点为宁波、象山、台州、玉环、温州、福鼎、宁德、福州、永泰、仙游、安溪、漳州、平和、潮州、揭阳、陆河、惠东、东莞。在浙江，它比 G15 更靠海，自象山至乐清跨越一个个海湾；在福建，它经永泰、仙游、安溪折向内陆，绕到莆田、泉州、厦门的后方；在广东，它向西穿过潮州、揭阳，经汕尾沿海的后方抵达惠州和东莞。
它由各省以各自名称修建的道路拼接而成：浙江的浙江沿海高速公路，又称甬台温高速公路复线；福建的福诏高速公路，又称沈海复线；广东的潮莞高速公路，原省高速编号 S20。2013 年的国家公路网规划将其编为 G15W3，2022 年的规划改编为 G1523。它在乐清、福鼎、宁德三处与 G15 共线，在福州、厦门、漳州一带又与福州绕城高速等多条高速公路共线。

en: The Zhejiang section is a chain of sea crossings: the Xiangshan Harbour bridge on the Ningbo section, then the Sanmen Bay, Taizhou Bay and Yueqing Bay bridges, and in Wenzhou the Oujiang North Estuary Bridge. The last, 7.913 km long, has a 2,090 m main bridge with two 800 m spans and is described by its builders as the world's first three-tower, four-span, double-deck steel-truss suspension bridge. The upper deck carries G1523 as a six-lane expressway for 100 km/h, the lower deck national road G228 as a six-lane class-I road for 80 km/h; the bridge used more than 300,000 tonnes of steel.

South of the Oujiang the 38.6 km from Lingkun to Gexiang is almost all viaduct, 98.4% of its length and described as the longest expressway bridge in Zhejiang; its Feiyun River crossing, the Gaoming bridge, is a cable-stayed bridge with a 380 m main span. In Fujian the Ningde part of the Ningde–Lianjiang road is 76.4% bridge and tunnel; its main structure, the Ningde Binhai bridge, is given as 11.04 km by the Fujian expressway company's Ningde branch, 11,117 m by Chinese Wikipedia and 5.43 km by China News Service in 2015; the Shacheng Bay bridge at the Zhejiang border, 2,054 m, crosses the bay in one span with footways on both sides. The Guangdong Chaozhou–Huizhou section, about 247 km, has 206 bridges totalling 76,941 m and 9 tunnels totalling 14,348 m.
zh: 浙江段是一连串跨海工程：宁波段的象山港大桥，其后是三门湾、台州湾、乐清湾三座跨海大桥，温州则有瓯江北口大桥。瓯江北口大桥全长 7.913 公里，主桥长 2090 米，主跨 800 米加 800 米，建设方称其为世界首座三塔四跨双层钢桁梁悬索桥。上层为甬莞高速，双向六车道，设计时速 100 公里；下层为国道 G228，双向六车道一级公路，设计时速 80 公里；全桥用钢 30 余万吨。

瓯江以南的灵昆至阁巷段 38.6 公里几乎全为高架，桥梁占主线长度的 98.4%，被称为浙江省最长的高速公路桥；跨飞云江的高明大桥为斜拉桥，主跨 380 米。福建的宁连高速宁德段桥隧比为 76.40%；控制性工程宁德滨海特大桥的长度，福建省高速公路公司宁德分公司给出 11.04 公里，中文维基百科作 11117 米，中新网 2015 年报道为 5.43 公里；闽浙界的沙埕湾跨海大桥全长 2054 米，一跨过湾，两侧设人行道。广东的潮惠高速约 247 公里，有桥梁 206 座共 76941 米、隧道 9 座共 14348 米。

en: The oldest parts are at the Guangdong end, built as local roads before there was a national number. The Hugang expressway across Dongguan, 56.36 km, of which G1523 uses the eastern end, opened on 27 September 2009, and the Huizhou–Dongguan section, 49.1 km, on 26 January 2010. In Zhejiang the Ningbo–Xiangshan section, 47 km over the Xiangshan Harbour bridge, opened at the end of December 2012. Fujian opened Fuzhou–Yongtai on 18 May 2013 and Yongtai–Xianyou on 28 December 2013, and the national highway plan of June 2013 drew the whole line as G15W3, Ningbo–Dongguan.

Most of the road came in 2016–2019. Guangdong's Chaozhou–Huizhou section, 247 km, opened on 28 December 2016 and the Chaozhou section to the Fujian border, about 65 km, on 28 December 2017. In Zhejiang the 225 km from Xiangshan to Yueqing, with the Sanmen Bay, Taizhou Bay and Yueqing Bay crossings, opened on 16 January 2019, and Lingkun–Cangnan, 95.5 km, on 15 November 2019. Fujian finished its Ningde section on 1 January 2020 and its whole 690 km on 18 January 2021, when the Shacheng Bay crossing at the Zhejiang border opened.

The last gap was the mouth of the Oujiang at Wenzhou. The Oujiang North Estuary Bridge was begun in 2017, its main span joined in December 2021, and it opened at 18:00 on 27 May 2022; Xinhua reported that day that G1523 was open throughout. In July 2022 the new national highway plan gave it its present number, G1523.
zh: 最早的路段在广东一端，修建时还只是地方高速公路，尚无国家编号。横贯东莞的虎岗高速全长 56.36 公里（G1523 利用其东端），于 2009 年 9 月 27 日通车，惠莞段 49.1 公里于 2010 年 1 月 26 日通车。浙江的宁波至象山段经象山港大桥，全长 47 公里，于 2012 年 12 月底通车。福建的福州至永泰段于 2013 年 5 月 18 日通车，永泰至仙游段于 2013 年 12 月 28 日通车；同年 6 月公布的国家公路网规划把全线定为 G15W3 宁波—东莞线。

大部分路段在 2016 至 2019 年间建成。广东的潮惠高速 247 公里于 2016 年 12 月 28 日通车，至闽粤界的潮州段约 65 公里于 2017 年 12 月 28 日通车。浙江的象山至乐清段 225 公里，连同三门湾、台州湾、乐清湾三座跨海大桥，于 2019 年 1 月 16 日通车；灵昆至苍南段 95.5 公里于 2019 年 11 月 15 日通车。福建宁德段于 2020 年 1 月 1 日全线贯通；2021 年 1 月 18 日闽浙界沙埕湾跨海通道通车，福建段 690 公里全线贯通。
最后的缺口在温州瓯江口。瓯江北口大桥 2017 年开工，2021 年 12 月主桥合龙，2022 年 5 月 27 日 18 时通车；新华社当日报道，甬莞高速全线正式通车。2022 年 7 月，新版国家公路网规划将其改编为现在的 G1523。

en: No total has been published; the road was financed by three provinces as more than a dozen separate projects. The Zhejiang coastal expressway as a whole was reported at close to ¥100 billion for about 380 km, the highest cost per kilometre among the published figures: the Xiangshan–Yueqing section alone cost ¥54.3 billion for 225 km, and the Oujiang North Estuary Bridge, invested and built by Wenzhou's municipal transport development group, was budgeted at ¥8.836 billion for 7.9 km.

Fujian's and Guangdong's figures are lower per kilometre: ¥10.568 billion for Fujian's 129.54 km Ningde section, ¥4.257 billion for the 20.2 km Shacheng Bay crossing, about ¥30.3 billion approved for Guangdong's 247 km Chaozhou–Huizhou section. The road is tolled, except for a stretch through the north of Fuzhou. To keep costs down for local drivers and make full use of the whole road, the Oujiang North Estuary Bridge was not tolled at the standard per-kilometre rate: class-1 and class-2 passenger vehicles pay ¥7.17.
zh: 全线没有公开的总造价；它由三省分十余个项目分别筹资建设。据报道，浙江沿海高速公路全长约 380 公里，投资近千亿元，在已公布的数字中每公里造价最高：仅象山至乐清段 225 公里就总投资 543 亿元；由温州市交发集团投资建设的瓯江北口大桥 7.9 公里，概算投资 88.36 亿元。
福建和广东每公里造价较低：福建宁德段 129.54 公里概算 105.68 亿元，沙埕湾跨海通道 20.2 公里总投资 42.57 亿元，广东潮惠高速 247 公里批复概算约 303 亿元。全线收费，福州北部有一段免费。为减轻群众出行负担、充分发挥整条甬莞高速的效益，瓯江北口大桥未按定额计费制定收费标准，一类、二类客车仅收 7.17 元。

en: Most of the newer sections are six-lane: Lingkun to Cangnan is signed for 120 km/h for cars, 100 km/h in tunnels, and the Oujiang bridge for 100 km/h. Crossing the Oujiang by the North Estuary Bridge cut the drive from central Yueqing to Wenzhou airport from more than an hour to fifteen minutes. In Fujian the Ningde–Lianjiang section is designed for 100 km/h.
zh: 较新的路段大多为六车道：灵昆至苍南段小客车标志速度 120 公里/小时，隧道段 100 公里/小时；瓯江北口大桥设计时速 100 公里。经北口大桥过江，乐清市区到温州机场的车程由 1 个多小时缩短至 15 分钟。福建宁连高速宁德段设计速度 100 公里/小时。

why.en: No route-wide figure is published. Like other national expressways, G1523 was financed and built province by province, from 2006 to 2022, and its cost is reported only per section; the sourced section costs are listed separately below.
why.zh: 未公布全线总造价。与其他国家高速公路一样，G1523 自 2006 年至 2022 年由各省分段筹资修建，造价仅按路段公布；有来源的路段造价另列如下。

why.en: No route-wide breakdown has been found. Of the sections checked, only the Oujiang North Estuary Bridge names its investor, Wenzhou's municipal transport development group; the road is tolled throughout except through northern Fuzhou.
why.zh: 未查到全线出资构成。在核查过的路段中，只有瓯江北口大桥写明了投资方——温州市交发集团；全线除福州北部一段外均收费。

Lingkun–Gexiang, 38.6 km: about ¥14.03 billion budgeted; Rui'an–Cangnan, 56.9 km: about ¥15.66 billion budgeted (2019). The whole Zhejiang coastal expressway was reported at close to ¥100 billion.

Shacheng Bay crossing, 20.2 km: ¥4.257 billion (2021). Yongtai–Xianyou, 50 km: about ¥5 billion (2013).

timeline.en: The Hugang expressway across Dongguan opens on 27 September.
timeline.zh: 9 月 27 日，横贯东莞的虎岗高速通车。

timeline.en: The Huizhou–Dongguan section opens on 26 January.
Ningbo–Xiangshan, over the Xiangshan Harbour bridge, opens at the end of December.
timeline.zh: 12 月底，经象山港大桥的宁波至象山段通车。

timeline.en: The June national highway plan numbers the line G15W3; Fuzhou–Yongtai opens on 18 May and Yongtai–Xianyou on 28 December.
timeline.zh: 6 月公布的国家公路网规划将全线编为 G15W3；5 月 18 日福州至永泰段、12 月 28 日永泰至仙游段通车。
12 月 28 日，潮惠高速 247 公里全线通车。

timeline.en: The Chaozhou section to the Fujian border opens on 28 December; work starts on the Oujiang North Estuary Bridge.
timeline.zh: 12 月 28 日，至闽粤界的潮州段通车；瓯江北口大桥开工。

timeline.en: Xiangshan–Yueqing opens on 16 January and Lingkun–Cangnan on 15 November.
timeline.zh: 1 月 16 日象山至乐清段通车，11 月 15 日灵昆至苍南段通车。

timeline.en: Fujian's Ningde section is complete on 1 January.
timeline.zh: 1 月 1 日，福建宁德段全线贯通。

timeline.en: The Shacheng Bay crossing opens on 18 January, completing the Fujian section.
timeline.zh: 1 月 18 日，沙埕湾跨海通道通车，福建段全线贯通。

timeline.en: The Oujiang North Estuary Bridge opens on 27 May and the road is open throughout; in July it is renumbered G1523.
timeline.zh: 5 月 27 日，瓯江北口大桥通车，甬莞高速全线通车；7 月改编为 G1523。
